{{Quote|Candoras sector. I also remember that it was shortly afterward that Nuso Esva launched the Braccio campaign and ended up nearly destroying half a dozen species.|Senior Captain Voss Parck|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The '''Braccio campaign''' was a military campaign launched by [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]<ref name="note" /> that nearly rendered six [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Speciecide|extinct]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]</ref> shortly after the warlord's [[Death/Legends|death]] during a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="Atlas Appendix">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]] between his forces and the [[Empire of the Hand]], Imperial [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] recalled to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] that the campaign occurred shortly after Esva's [[Battle of the Poln system|incursion]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]].<ref name="Atlas Appendix1">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]</ref> The Braccio campaign<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> shared its name with the [[Braccio system/Legends|Braccio system]], a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="Atlas Appendix2">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Braccio campaign was mentioned in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
